instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level from a slightly rear angle. Set in an outdoor covered training area with concrete flooring and white pillars under bright daylight. On the left, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) has his back partially turned as he lunges forward to throw a punch. On the right, the man in the green long-sleeve shirt (R3) stands holding up focus mitts to block the strike. The punch from the man in the beige t-shirt is directed at the mitt held by the man in the green long-sleeve shirt. Bright natural daylight casts soft shadows across the scene.
elements: R1 lunges forward to throw a punch at R3's focus mitts
R3 holds up focus mitts to block or receive R1's strike
R1 is the striker while R3 is the mitt holder in the combat drill
focus mitts are the contact-relevant objects used for the punch
the scene is an outdoor covered training area
